# Merriam-Webster

> America's most trusted dictionary and language resource, providing comprehensive definitions, word games, and vocabulary tools for learners, word enthusiasts, and language professionals.

Merriam-Webster offers multiple dictionary products including the flagship Collegiate Dictionary, premium Unabridged Dictionary with 700,000+ definitions, specialized resources like the Medical Dictionary and Slang Dictionary, plus interactive tools like Word Finder for Scrabble and daily vocabulary features. The site serves students, educators, writers, and word game players with authoritative language reference materials.

## Key Topics

- Merriam-Webster Collegiate Dictionary
- Unabridged Dictionary
- Word of the Day
- Vocabulary building
- Language learning
- Word games (Quordle, Blossom)
- Scrabble and word game solving
- Slang and contemporary language
- Medical Dictionary
- Thesaurus
- Dictionary apps
- Student and kids dictionaries
- Grammar and usage
- Etymology and word origins
- SAT/ACT vocabulary prep

## Core Dictionary Products

- [Merriam-Webster: America's Most Trusted Dictionary](https://www.merriam-webster.com/): Main homepage with 300K+ definitions, word games, and grammar resources
- [The Unabridged Dictionary by Merriam-Webster](https://unabridged.merriam-webster.com/): Premium unabridged dictionary with 700K+ definitions and comprehensive coverage
- [About the Unabridged | Merriam-Webster Unabridged](https://unabridged.merriam-webster.com/info/about-the-unabridged.html): Information about Merriam-Webster Unabridged dictionary features and scope
- [Merriam-Webster's Collegiate Dictionary, Twelfth Edition](https://www.merriam-webster.com/collegiate-dictionary-twelfth-edition): Product page for the new Twelfth Edition Collegiate Dictionary

## Vocabulary and Learning Tools

- [Word of the Day Calendar | Merriam-Webster](https://www.merriam-webster.com/word-of-the-day/calendar): Daily vocabulary feature with podcast, email, and social media options
- [Student Dictionary for Kids | Merriam-Webster](https://www.merriam-webster.com/kids): Kid-friendly dictionary with educational word games like Quordle
- [The Merriam-Webster Vocabulary Builder](https://shop.merriam-webster.com/products/the-merriam-webster-vocabulary-builder): Vocabulary book for SAT/ACT/TOEFL prep with Greek and Latin roots

## Word Games and Tools

- [Word Finder: Scrabble & Word Game Solver | Merriam-Webster](https://www.merriam-webster.com/wordfinder): Scrabble helper and word game solver with advanced letter search
- [Dictionary and Word Game Apps | Merriam-Webster](https://www.merriam-webster.com/apps): Mobile apps for iOS/Android including dictionary and Scrabble tools

## Specialized Dictionaries

- [Slang Dictionary - Merriam-Webster](https://www.merriam-webster.com/slang): Dictionary of trending slang, Gen Z terms, and social media language

## Optional

- [Merch – Merriam-Webster Shop](https://shop.merriam-webster.com/collections/merch): Merchandise and accessories for language lovers including tote bags
